how_to_find: Open your copy of the repo on GitHub. Look at the date of the newest commit on the main branch. The original repo (keyona-rerev/tiktoktransmcp) had its newest commit, 8101f46 (Pin httpx explicitly for the Apify client), on 2026-08-28. If your newest commit is the same, you are on the version in the baseline entry.
